paper.title: Synapse: Trajectory-as-Exemplar Prompting with Memory for Computer Control
paper.central_claim: Synapse(状态抽象+轨迹即 exemplar 提示+exemplar 记忆)在 MiniWoB++ 用 48 个任务的演示解决 64 个任务达 99.2% 平均成功率,并在 Mind2Web 上较此前 SOTA 提示方法步 SR 相对提升 56%(作者原主张)

provenance.receipt_ref_note: no receipt/run-record path exposed to the worker; session_id taken from CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID

sections_read: Appendix B (environment details, action-space listing, state-abstraction prompt sources)
Appendix C (prompt listings C.1 terminal, C.2 book-flight, C.3 text-transform failure, C.4 Mind2Web; sampled)
missing_sections: Figure 3/4/5/6/7 plot content (bar charts; per-task numbers also in Table 3)
Appendix C.2 book-flight prompt listing read only partially (structure verified, not every exemplar token)
other sections not needed for this review

evidence.quote: In MiniWoB ++ , Synapse achieves a 99.2% average success rate (a 10% relative improvement) across 64 tasks using demonstrations from only 48 tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: 中心主张(MiniWoB++)

evidence.quote: Synapse also exhibits a 56% relative improvement in average step success rate over the previous state-of-the-art prompting scheme in Mind2Web.
evidence.support_explanation: 中心主张(Mind2Web,相对提升基于低绝对值)

evidence.quote: we introduce Synapse , a computer agent featuring three key components: i) state abstraction
evidence.support_explanation: 三组件

evidence.quote: First, the limited context length of LLMs, combined with complex computer states, poses challenges for few-shot learning.
evidence.support_explanation: gap 1:上下文长度+复杂状态

evidence.quote: Second, the exemplar structures used by existing computer agents can lead to error accumulation in multi-round LLM queries and struggle to capture the complete trajectory information.
evidence.support_explanation: gap 2:exemplar 结构

evidence.quote: Third, current computer agents require task-specific exemplars within a predefined scope.
evidence.support_explanation: gap 3:任务特定 exemplar

evidence.quote: For scenarios where the context can handle multiple states, such as email-inbox in MiniWoB ++ , we apply explicit abstraction through state-observation pairs
evidence.support_explanation: 显式状态抽象=few-shot 提示 LLM 提取观测

evidence.quote: we adopt implicit abstraction by pairing task descriptions and state-parsing code
evidence.support_explanation: 隐式抽象=LLM 生成解析代码

evidence.quote: If the code execution raises an error, we ask the LLM to perform zero-shot state abstraction.
evidence.support_explanation: 唯一的错误回退

evidence.quote: Although this reduces the recall from 86% to 53%, i.e., only 53% of the clean observations contain the target element, it achieves a higher step success rate (Sec. 4.4 ).
evidence.support_explanation: Mind2Web:top-k 3/5 使召回 86→53%(47% 目标元素不在观测中)

evidence.quote: Subsequently, the LLM is prompted with the current trajectory (the task description and previous clean observations and actions) to produce the next action.
evidence.support_explanation: TaE:完整轨迹 exemplar+当前清洁观测历史

evidence.quote: it implicitly prompts the LLM to generate temporally abstracted actions and query new states only when necessary
evidence.support_explanation: 多动作后才取新状态(时间抽象)

evidence.quote: We retrieve the top three exemplars from memory and use the most common one to retrieve its exemplars
evidence.support_explanation: MiniWoB++ 检索规则:top3 取最常任务,再取该任务全部 exemplar

evidence.quote: In Mind2Web, we encode the website name, domain, and task description as metadata for trajectories in the training set, and retrieve the corresponding exemplars of matched metadata for few-shot learning.
evidence.support_explanation: Mind2Web 记忆键=站点名+领域+任务描述

evidence.quote: We only store the training set in the exemplar memory.
evidence.support_explanation: Mind2Web 记忆只含训练集

evidence.quote: we query gpt-3.5-turbo-0301 and run 50 episodes to produce the results for each task
evidence.support_explanation: MiniWoB++:gpt-3.5-turbo-0301,每任务 50 episode

evidence.quote: We configure the temperature to 0, i.e., greedy decoding.
evidence.support_explanation: 贪心解码,单次

evidence.quote: The states are obtained from the environment, while the cleaned observations are provided by humans.
evidence.support_explanation: 显式抽象的 exemplar 观测由人给出

evidence.quote: The code is tested by executing it with states derived from the environment and having its results reviewed by humans.
evidence.support_explanation: 隐式抽象代码经人审核

evidence.quote: With a mean success rate of 99.2%, Synapse achieves human-level performance and outperforms all baselines on MiniWoB ++ .
evidence.support_explanation: 主结果
各方法覆盖任务数:Ours 64 vs Human/CC-Net 104
平均分:跨方法均值使用不同任务子集

evidence.quote: For the 16 unseen tasks, the average success rate is almost 100%.
evidence.support_explanation: 16 个‘未见’任务

evidence.quote: Of the 64 tasks that we test (see Tab. 3 ), 48 are provided with exemplars, and 16 are unseen tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: 48 个有 exemplar,16 个无

evidence.quote: The average number of exemplars per task for RCI and Synapse is 1.32 and 3.45, respectively.
evidence.support_explanation: exemplar 数量更多

evidence.quote: RCI relies on self-correction (task, state, and agent grounding) while Synapse does not.
evidence.support_explanation: 与 RCI 的对比设置不同

evidence.quote: Most of the observed failure cases are due to incorrect reasoning by LLMs.
evidence.support_explanation: 失败原因定性
基线 MindAct (GPT-3.5)
+状态抽象
+TaE
完整;整任务 SR 仅 2.4/0.6/1.5

evidence.quote: In Mind2Web, direct generation with the top five elements improves the success rate by 32% compared to MCQ with the top-50 elements (Tab. 1 )
evidence.support_explanation: ‘状态抽象’增益=直接生成+top5 vs MCQ+top50,两因素混合

evidence.quote: In Mind2Web, the memory further improves Synapse with state abstraction and TaE prompting, leading to a 6% improvement in Step SR for cross-task and cross-website generalization.
evidence.support_explanation: 记忆在 cross-task/website 提升

evidence.quote: Cross-Domain | 32.9 | 0.2 | -0.2
evidence.support_explanation: 跨域检索距离最大,增益≈0(GPT +0.2,CodeLlama −0.2)

evidence.quote: This accounts for why memory does not aid in cross-domain generalization, as these domains are entirely unseen.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认跨域记忆无益

evidence.quote: High inference latency is a major concern due to the use of LLMs.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认时延

evidence.quote: Another concern is our dependence on the quality of exemplars.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认依赖 exemplar 质量

evidence.quote: Recently, RCI ( Kim et al., 2023 ) employed recursive self-correction to solve MiniWoB ++ with a success rate of 90.6% in 54 tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻 RCI

evidence.quote: Pix2Act ( Shaw et al., 2023 ) solved 59 MiniWoB ++ tasks with tree search and BC on 1.3 million demonstrations.
evidence.support_explanation: 并发 Pix2Act(训练式)

evidence.quote: WebAgent ( Gur et al., 2023b ) employed a small element-ranking model for HTML state filtering and an LLM for few-shot action generation, but it did not investigate the exemplar structure and memory.
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻 WebAgent

evidence.quote: It prompts LLMs to predict the next action using multi-choice questions (MCQ), with candidate choices generated by an element-ranking model.
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻 MindAct

evidence.quote: We use the same multiple-choice formulation as MindAct , and include three demonstration examples for in-context learning.
evidence.support_explanation: 固定来源:MindAct GPT-3.5 基线=MCQ+3 个 demo;与 Synapse 的设置(直接生成、top-5、检索 exemplar)不同
固定来源核对:Synapse 表中 MindAct(GPT-3.5) 数值与 Mind2Web 原表一致

signatures.object: 每步送入 LLM 的状态表示(基线=原始 HTML 或 top-50 元素)

signatures.operation: few-shot 让 LLM 把原始状态改写成任务相关‘清洁观测’(显式),或生成解析代码执行得到观测(隐式);代码报错则零样本抽象
signatures.conditions: 状态过长时用隐式;Mind2Web 用排序器截断(召回 86→53%)
signatures.selection_rule_data: exemplar 与解析代码由作者人工提供/审核
signatures.persistence: 抽象 prompt 存入 exemplar 记忆
signatures.later_use: 按任务检索时随轨迹一起取回
signatures.claimed_effect: 解决 book-flight;email-inbox-nl-turk 52%→100%;Mind2Web 步 SR +32%(相对 MindAct GPT-3.5)
signatures.failure_boundary: Mind2Web 召回降到 53%(47% 的清洁观测不含目标);抽象质量依赖人写 exemplar

signatures.object: few-shot exemplar 的结构(基线=高层 plan 或 MCQ 单步)
signatures.information: 完整成功轨迹 ⟨task, obs, action, …, obs, action⟩,LLM 可输出多个动作直到需要新状态

signatures.conditions: 需要状态抽象把轨迹压进上下文
signatures.feedback: 执行后的新观测;无自我纠错/反思
signatures.selection_rule_data: 无自动选择;exemplar 为人工演示
signatures.persistence: 当前 episode 内的轨迹在上下文中累积
signatures.claimed_effect: guess-number/use-spinner/use-autocomplete 100/100/98 vs RCI 20/88/58;Mind2Web 步 SR 再 +19% 相对状态抽象变体
signatures.failure_boundary: LLM 推理错误(count-shape 数错、text-transform 抄错字符)

signatures.object: exemplar 记忆与检索(基线=任务→exemplar 的硬编码映射)

signatures.operation: 欧氏距离最近邻检索;MiniWoB++ 取 top3 中最多任务并取其全部 exemplar;Mind2Web 取匹配元数据的 exemplar
signatures.output: few-shot 提示中的 exemplar 集合

signatures.selection_rule_data: 检索相似度;exemplar 本身来自人类演示,非 agent 自产

retention_trace.reason: Synapse 为静态 ICL harness+检索增强;记忆库来自人类演示/人工审核的抽象 prompt,不含 agent 自产改动的选择-留存闭环,作者也未声称自我改进。故不编造 retained 闭环;改动对象仅为‘提示结构+检索’。

gap.author_gap: 现有 LLM 计算机 agent:(1) 上下文长度+复杂状态限制 exemplar 数;(2) exemplar 结构(高层 plan、MCQ)无法表示完整轨迹并在多轮查询中累积错误;(3) 依赖任务专用 exemplar,忽略任务相似性、泛化差
gap.checked_gap: gap(1)(3)有 MiniWoB++ 逐任务证据(RCI 无法解 book-flight/click-pie、RCI 需 54 套任务专用 exemplar);gap(2)在 guess-number/use-spinner/use-autocomplete 上 RCI 20/88/58 vs Synapse 100/100/98 有对应,但 RCI 含自纠错且基座/exemplar 数不同(1.32 vs 3.45),不能单独归因于 exemplar 结构;最近邻 RCI/AdaPlanner/Pix2Act 原文未在本批固定集合,MindAct 已固定(2306.06070)
